summary: The enable condition is inverted: the counter increments when en is low instead of high.
reasoning: The testbench increments its expected count when en is high (tb/counter_tb.v:10-12). After reset it sets en=1, but the baseline remains at zero on the first enabled cycle (baseline:simulation). Changing the condition at rtl/counter.v:4 aligns the counter with that behavior; no prior patch has been tested.
